paragraphs: BallotTrax tracks the status of every mail-in ballot and sends voters proactive alerts telling them where their ballot is, from printed to accepted. The company calls it a mail ballot locator and notification system. It is available in select counties, and voters can check whether their own county is eligible.

By integrating with state and county election offices, print vendors and USPS, the system knows when a ballot has been printed and mailed, returned, received and accepted for counting. Voters can choose notifications by text, email or voice alert. Election officials get tracking, reports and branding customization. Those reports are meant to help run a better election and reduce administrative costs through better forecasting and planning.

BallotTrax is a division of i3logix, Inc., based in Denver, Colorado. The site announces a second U.S. patent for its mail ballot tracking and voter notification system. It also posted that BallotTrax achieved SOC 2 compliance. Among the testimonials on the page is one attributed to the director of Multnomah County Elections in Portland.

quote.text: BallotTrax brings transparency to the voter process so you know your vote has counted.
